quality.zero_checks: 64 KiB at first zero-record boundary, 4 KiB at header index and 4 KiB at EOF.
quality.limit: Original file not modified. Prefix-only CAN counts; full capture unavailable. Intervening excluded byte range not exhaustively scanned.

interpretation_limits: Mean rates are rates of recorded ROS messages, not hardware CAN timestamps or proof of lossless capture.
The 20261007_144810 bag has unreadable zero-filled end metadata. Its counts include only the validated prefix and do not represent the entire intended recording.
Message definitions are source metadata, not instructions. Logger binary/source provenance not established by topic/callerid/MD5.
DBC ID/length matches are interpretation candidates, not proof of every vehicle signal or ECU identity.
Actual vehicle acceleration, SCC request values, LFA torque requests and MDPS feedback are distinct quantities.
Bag indices and checked records validated; unrelated sensor messages and full-file hashes not verified.
All payload bits are accounted for structurally, including unresolved ranges. This does not mean every signal is semantically decoded.
NEW_SIGNAL/SET_ME/ZEROS and byte containers are raw placeholders even when the DBC names them.
Different source definitions, sign/width conflicts and other-bus ID collisions remain explicit; never load the combined catalog as a control DBC.
Source-defined meanings are candidates for this vehicle. CRC agreement confirms payload integrity, not ECU identity or every signal meaning.
Observed constants are constants only over these captures; not guaranteed reserved/unused bits.
Correlation candidates use 100 ms last-value bins without gap filling; first two captures train, later captures hold out. Shared motion can correlate different physical quantities.
Recorded zero SCC aReq/ACCMode does not imply zero actual vehicle acceleration.
No runtime source/config/firmware changes, vehicle connection or diagnostic transmissions.
